0022600088.text: Toronto hosts Chicago as both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with neither side having played a game yet this year. Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (out, foot) are unavailable for the Raptors, while the Bulls are without Dailyn Swain (out, illness), Jordan Hawkins (out, illness), and Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), and Isaac Okoro, Tobe Awaka, and Zach Collins are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Raptors won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 139-109 win in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
